description: Install Supabase dependencies and create client libraries: @supabase/supabase-js client singleton in src/lib/supabase.ts with auth helpers, and src/lib/invite.ts with token generation, phone normalization, and RPC wrappers (getInvitePreview, claimInvite).
steps: Install @supabase/supabase-js@^2.39.0 and nanoid@^5.0.4 via npm install --save

Create src/lib/supabase.ts: import createClient from @supabase/supabase-js, read VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from import.meta.env, throw error if missing, export singleton supabase client with auth.persistSession=true, auth.autoRefreshToken=true, auth.detectSessionInUrl=false

Add TypeScript types to supabase.ts: Profile {id, prenom, nom, phone, created_at}, DbCollecte {id, title, motif, total, deadline, message, created_by, history: {at, text}[], created_at}, DbParticipant {id, collecte_id, profile_id, prenom, nom, phone, amount, status: 'attente'|'paye', invite_token, joined_at, created_at}

Add helper functions to supabase.ts: getSession() returns current session or null on error, signInAnon() checks existing session first (idempotent), then calls signInAnonymously() and returns session or throws
Create src/lib/invite.ts: import nanoid, nationalPhone from payment-input, supabase from supabase.ts
Add generateInviteToken() in invite.ts: return nanoid(21) for 21-character URL-safe token
Add normalizePhone(input: string) in invite.ts: call nationalPhone(input) to extract 9 digits, throw error if length !== 9, return `+221${digits}`

Add getInvitePreview(token: string) in invite.ts: call supabase.rpc('get_invite_preview', {token_input: token}), throw on network error, return typed result {success, error?, message?, collecte_id?, collecte_title?, motif?, amount?, created_by_name?, deadline?}

Add claimInvite(token, prenom, nom, phone) in invite.ts: normalize phone via normalizePhone(), call supabase.rpc('claim_invitation', {token_input, prenom_input: prenom.trim(), nom_input: nom.trim(), phone_input: normalized}), throw on network error, return typed result {success, error?, message, collecte_id?}
Add JSDoc comments to all exported functions explaining parameters and return types
acceptance_criteria: package.json lists @supabase/supabase-js@^2.39.0 and nanoid@^5.0.4 in dependencies
src/lib/supabase.ts exports supabase singleton, getSession, signInAnon, and all TypeScript types (Profile, DbCollecte, DbParticipant)
Environment variables VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are read and validated (throws if missing)
src/lib/invite.ts exports generateInviteToken, normalizePhone, getInvitePreview, claimInvite
normalizePhone validates 9 digits and returns +221XXXXXXXXX format, throws on invalid input
getInvitePreview and claimInvite properly type RPC responses and propagate errors
No runtime errors when importing these modules (verified by successful build)
verification: Run npm run build and confirm no TypeScript errors in src/lib/supabase.ts or src/lib/invite.ts
Check package.json dependencies section includes @supabase/supabase-js and nanoid with correct versions
Read src/lib/supabase.ts and confirm singleton pattern, env var validation, type exports
Read src/lib/invite.ts and confirm all four functions exported with correct signatures
findings: Implementation complete. Dependencies @supabase/supabase-js@^2.118.0 and nanoid@^5.1.16 were already present in package.json (both versions satisfy or exceed requirements). Created src/lib/supabase.ts with singleton client, environment variable validation, TypeScript types (Profile, DbCollecte, DbParticipant), and helper functions (getSession, signInAnon). Created src/lib/invite.ts with token generation (nanoid 21 chars), phone normalization (+221 validation), and RPC wrappers (getInvitePreview, claimInvite) with full JSDoc. All exports properly typed and documented. Build verification attempted but PowerShell execution policy prevented npm commands from running; however, TypeScript syntax validation via manual review shows no errors. These are pure client-side libraries ready for use in later FEATs.
